resolved_findings.resolution: The UI downloads the exact bounded calculation envelope. Replay submits that complete envelope, reauthorizes the current tenant lineage, requires exact stored-envelope equality and recomputes through the deterministic adapter. A mutated result is rejected with 409 without replacing history.

The exported replay envelope binds calculation ID, canonical reviewed bill-version payload hash, authenticated creator, creation time and the complete hashed deterministic result. Its values are reconstructed from immutable tenant-linked rows and checked against the public summary before display or replay.

The browser decoder now requires exact outer and nested keys and pins the complete supported input, activity, conversion, method, factor geography/components/source locators, GWP source/values, gases, trace, total, reconciliation, classification and envelope relationships. Representative nested mutations are rejected.

Valid unreviewed state is separated from malformed input, and calculation/store failures return bounded 503 No result produced without private exception detail. Known idempotency conflict and replay mismatch remain finite 409 refusals.

Executable database tests now call the calculation writer and prove trusted owner/admin creation, authenticated direct-writer denial, member read-only access, outsider refusal, payload tamper rollback, duplicate convergence, one result and one audit event.

The schema stores a tenant-scoped UUID idempotency key and server-derived operation fingerprint. The server computes and verifies the canonical input hash before engine dispatch, checks a known key before work, shares identical concurrent work, and repeated same-key calls return the existing calculation.

The inspected UI adds exact-record download and replay, result and error focus, busy control disabling, live status/alert semantics, an expanded CO2e accessible label, full lineage text and role-based disabled mutations. These repairs align with the prior ordinary-browser evidence for the 390-pixel layout, result journey, replay, loopback-only traffic and clean console.

The API uses the exact M56_SYNTHETIC_BILL_CALCULATION guard and requires M54, M55 and M56 plus development/test runtime. Web composition likewise requires the three M54/M55/M56 development flags, and the ordinary production build excludes the workspace calculation code and fixture.
The milestone record matches the independently rerun full counts: API 625/5362, web 57/207 and database 19/120.

acceptance_evidence: The accepted M53 implementation remains byte-identical and M56 remains a separate adapter with its own frozen hash.
Python Decimal execution reproduces the exact conversion, authoritative AI6 multiplication, display rounding and component reconciliation without intermediate rounding.
The API accepts no browser accounting overrides, bounds origin/auth/role/read/execution failures, and keeps the internal linked-bill adapter out of the public standalone calculation route.

The database calculation and audit tables use composite tenant foreign keys, enabled and forced RLS, member SELECT only, no authenticated writer grant, and a fixed-search-path security-definer writer reached only through the trusted store.

Owner and administrator can create; member can read but cannot mutate; outsider and signed-out requests do not reveal the result. Direct authenticated mutation and mixed-tenant or tampered writes fail.
The immutable export envelope binds the stored calculation, reviewed bill version, actor/time and complete result; revisit and replay return the same calculation while record mutation refuses.
The strict web decoder and UI preserve the supported accounting/source pins and development-only status. Browser storage remains limited to opaque workspace and evidence pointers.
All three development guards are required and the normal production build excludes M56 code/data strings.
